name: Tandoori Oven (Logan) Clay-Oven Chicken Tikka & Lamb Botti Kabob over Basmati Rice
whyItWorks: Boneless chicken breast cubes marinated in cultured yogurt (lactose broken down by live cultures and baking) roasted dry in the clay tandoor oven and served with basmati rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mild Chicken Tikka (dry tandoor-roasted cubes) with steamed basmati rice and Plain Naan; skip the raw sliced red onions on the sizzling platter.
watchOuts: Push aside the raw sizzling onions and bell peppers underneath the meat
